name: pilaster
description: Rhythmic pilasters (壁柱): 1-wide piers projecting 1-2 blocks out of a flat wall face at a fixed spacing, both wall ends always covered. Optional base/capital material segmentation; projection=2 steps from a deep base to a shallow shaft.
when_to_use: Any flat wall longer than ~7 blocks that reads as a blank plane — the #1 'AI look' giveaway. Use the style card's details.depth.pilaster values. origin = one END of the wall face at ground level; pilasters project OUTWARD, so the wall itself must already stand.

origin.notes: one end of the wall face at ground level

side.notes: outward direction of the wall face; north/south = wall runs along x, east/west = along z

spacing.notes: 3-6 reads best; from the style card's details.depth.pilaster.spacing

material.notes: shaft; usually the wall primary or secondary
